question: Who among the following cricketers has won the ’Sir Garfield Sobers Award’ for the ICC Male Cricketer of the Decade and ICC Men’s ODI Cricketer of the Decade Award in December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli**__ is an Indian cricketer who now serves as the Test captain for the Indian cricket team.
 
• Virat Kohli won the ’Sir Garfield Sobers Award’ for the ICC Male Cricketer of the Decade and ICC Men’s ODI Cricketer of the Decade Award in December 2020.
 
• He scored **20,396 runs** in all international cricket during the time period.
 
• Virat Kohli was a member of the Indian squad that won the **2011 ICC Cricket World Cup and the 2013 ICC Champions Trophy.**
 
• He was also named ICC Cricketer of the Year in both 2017 and 2018.
 
• He is the first cricketer to have won the T20 World Cup Player of the Tournament twice.
 
• In one-day internationals, he has the **second-most centuries (43)**, after only Sachin Tendulkar (49).
 
• He is the fastest player to reach 10,000 runs in an ODI in terms of innings, taking 54 fewer than the previous record of 259 innings.
 
• The ICC Decade Awards honour the top players in cricket during the previous ten years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Men's Test Cricketer of the Decade award went to **Steve Smith.**
 
• The ICC Spirit of Cricket Award of the Decade went to **MS Dhoni.**
 
• Ellyse Perry has been named the International Cricket Council's Women's T20I Cricketer of the Decade.
 
• **Joe Root** won the ICC Player of the Month in August 2021.
